name: AFR 896 皮托管加温，GPS高度地速失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 896, you are from Paris to Wuhan, you are flying at 11300 meters, approaching XIY, call Xi'an Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是AFR 896，从巴黎飞往武汉，当前高度11300米，接近XIY，请呼叫西安管制。
cards.referenceText: Xi'an Control, AFR 896, maintaining 11300 meters, approaching XIY.

cards.audioText: B: You check with Xi'an Control if there is any turbulence reported by preceding aircraft at 10700 meters?
cards.audioTextZh: 向西安管制询问前机在10700米是否报告过颠簸。
cards.referenceText: Xi'an Control, AFR 896, is there any turbulence reported by preceding aircraft at 10700 meters?
cards.referenceTextZh: 西安管制，AFR 896，请问前机在10700米是否报告过颠簸？

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 896, you are the first aircraft in my sector, there is no report here.
B: Tell the controller you want to descend to 10700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，你是我扇区内第一架航空器，这里没有报告。告诉管制员你希望下降至10700米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, request descend to 10700 meters, AFR 896.

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, descend and maintain 10700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，下降并保持10700米。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 10700 meters, AFR 896.

cards.audioText: B: You are experiencing severe turbulence at 10700 meters, the pitot static heating feature has malfunctioned, you want to fly back to 11300 meters to avoid turbulence and ice area. This is an Urgent call.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在10700米遇到严重颠簸，皮托静压加温功能故障，希望回到11300米以避开颠簸和结冰区域。这是紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Xi'an Control, AFR 896, we are experiencing severe turbulence at 10700 meters, the pitot static heating feature has malfunctioned, request fly back to 11300 meters to avoid turbulence and ice area.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，西安管制，AFR 896，我们在10700米遇到严重颠簸，皮托静压加温故障，申请回到11300米以避开颠簸和结冰区域。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, climb and maintain 11300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，爬升并保持11300米。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 11300 meters, AFR 896.

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, contact Zhengzhou Control on 132.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，联系郑州管制132.35。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, radar contact, direct to ZHO, descend to 11000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，雷达联系，直飞ZHO，下降至11000米。
cards.referenceText: Direct to ZHO, descend to 11000 meters, AFR 896.

cards.audioText: B: Ask to climb to 11600 meters due icing.
cards.audioTextZh: 因结冰申请爬升至11600米。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, AFR 896, request climb to 11600 meters due icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，AFR 896，因结冰申请爬升至11600米。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, climb to 11600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，爬升至11600米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 11600 meters, AFR 896.

cards.audioText: B: You have established contact with Wuhan Control, initiated descent for Runway 36R, during descent, airspeed and altitude readings are abnormal, possibly due to ice blockage, advise Wuhan Control this situation. This is an Urgent call.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已与武汉管制建立联系，开始为36右跑道下降。下降过程中，空速和高度读数异常，可能由结冰堵塞造成，请向武汉管制说明情况。这是紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR 896, our airspeed and altitude readings are abnormal, possibly due to ice blockage.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，AFR 896，我们的空速和高度读数异常，可能由结冰堵塞造成。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, turn right heading 240.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，右转航向240。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, AFR 896.

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 896, advise your intention.
B: Tell controller that your GPS altitude and groundspeed is not accurate compared to barometric indications, but you can still maintain a stable flight, request descend to leave icing area.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，报告意图。告诉管制员，与气压高度指示相比，你的GPS高度和地速不准确，但仍能保持稳定飞行，申请下降脱离结冰区域。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 896, our GPS altitude and groundspeed is not accurate, but we can still maintain a stable flight, request descend to leave icing area.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 896，我们的GPS高度和地速不准确，但仍能保持稳定飞行，申请下降脱离结冰区域。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, descend to 3600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，下降至3600米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3600 meters, AFR 896.

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 896, radar shows you are at 4800 meters, what's your current GPS altitude?
B: Tell the controller GPS altitude is 3600 meters, request descend to 1800 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：AFR 896，雷达显示你在4800米，你当前GPS高度是多少？
告诉管制员GPS高度为3600米，并申请下降至1800米。
cards.referenceText: Our GPS altitude is 3600 meters, request descend to 1800 meters, AFR 896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们的GPS高度是3600米，申请下降至1800米，AFR 896。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 896, another aircraft has information with regards to the differences between his barometric and GPS altitude, I have him on 3000 meters, his reported GPS is 3600 meters.
B: Acknowledge the transmission request further descent and leave icing area.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，另一架航空器提供了气压高度与GPS高度差异的信息。我给他3000米，他报告的GPS高度是3600米。确认收到，并申请继续下降以离开结冰区域。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 896, roger, request further descent and leave icing area.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 896，收到，申请继续下降并脱离结冰区域。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, contact Tower on 124.35, we have informed them your altimeter errors.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，联系塔台124.35，我们已通知他们你的高度表误差。
cards.referenceText: 124.35, roger, thanks, AFR 896.

cards.audioText: B: You left the icing area and your instruments have returned to normal, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已离开结冰区域，仪表恢复正常，请向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 896, we left the icing area and our instruments have returned to normal.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 896，我们已离开结冰区域，仪表已恢复正常。

cards.audioText: B: You have established on the ILS Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已建立36右跑道ILS。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 896, established on the ILS Runway 36R.

cards.audioText: C: AFR 896, wind calm, Runway 36R, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 896，静风，36右跑道，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared to land, AFR 896.
